description: List videos for a YouTube channel with view counts, publish dates, durations, and URLs. Pass a channelId (UC...) or a channel handle. Sort by "latest" or "popular"; paginate with continuationToken. Example: scrapecreators_youtube_channel({ handle: "ThePatMcAfeeShow", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: ScrapeCreators API key (sign up at https://app.scrapecreators.com)

continuationToken.description: Pagination token returned as continuationToken in a previous response (optional)

handle.description: YouTube channel handle (alternative to channelId), e.g. "ThePatMcAfeeShow"

includeExtras.description: "true" to include likes, comments, and description per video (optional)

name: scrapecreators_youtube_channel
title: Scrapecreators Youtube Channel
